claims.statement: Independently compare the actual27 public declarations (20theorems/7definitions), all binders, the exact ten-part root contract and Lean definitions with the explicitly scoped informal claims. Check actual real sine/cosine/sqrt/pi and HasDerivAt/deriv, natural-index finite sum including n=0 algebra and n>0 negativity on 0<x<1, n=2,x=1/2 old-W counterexample, endpoint coefficient algebra/negativity rather than a Taylor remainder, and conditional scalar FH left/right contributions with opposite velocities, square mirror equalities, gap difference and nonzero-jump stationarity. Explain jump=rho_left-rho_right when identifying the scalar FH formula with the informal single-interface convention. It is not a formal proof of spectral differentiability, weighted normalization integral, Volterra continuity, root isolation, the exact n=2 Jacobian determinant, Taylor remainder or min-max asymptotics. Detect hidden assumptions, tautological aliases, vacuous hypotheses or semantic scope inflation. Materialize a natural-language readback of the meaningful compound root in your reasons/limitations; no blind-readback status is claimed.

Audit actual independent-execution-v2 native dispatch/completion (fresh fork_context=false, identity distinct from authors), frozen final source/script/config/runtime hashes, the new direct compilation (no author --resume-positive), own newly compiled olean/import resolution, actual expected target matching, all public types and transitive axioms, commands/stdout/stderr/exit/status and before/after checks. Both deliberate old-W and old-mirror controls must actually exit nonzero for type mismatch. Do not replace observed failure with author PASS; original author exporter failures and author positive reuse are preserved and disclosed. Verify semantic closure allows only standard propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound with no sorry/admit/unsafe/custom assumption leakage into the claims. Current public source must be the byte-identical final source used by this executor. Readable compact indexes are derived; full raw receipts are gzip-mapped and available. Unpack/inspect raw evidence as needed; compiled objects are archival .bin rather than a live shared cache. State source/object/import/environment boundaries and that external compiler/Mathlib are pinned inputs rather than rebuilt or redistributed. This is evidence review, not a demand for a redundant third compiler run or full Lake build. Unavailable actual execution or material type/axiom discrepancy means INCOMPLETE/CHANGES_REQUIRED.
